title: Evaluate dedicated X API versus xAI X search
description: Compare xAI x_search with the official X API for exact post/user/handle/date/query retrieval, citations, cost, rate limits, and auth boundaries. Keep xAI as the current dedicated path; add a second adapter only if a measured workflow needs controls or coverage it cannot provide.

logs.msg: Current official X docs confirm a complementary gap: xAI x_search is best for semantic/model-mediated X context with handles/dates/media understanding; official X API provides exact query operators, direct post text/IDs/timestamps, recent and full-archive endpoints, pagination, distinct rate limits, and pay-per-resource billing. Decision: implement an explicit X API adapter behind separate credentials and metered policy; do not replace or auto-fallback from xAI.
